sources.title: GitHub - FrenchKnuckles/ANLP_A1
sources.snippet: This repository contains a PyTorch implementation of a Seq2Seq Transformer trained to decrypt a substitution cipher. The study performs a controlled ablation over 5 architectural configurations to analyze their impact on training speed, memory, and task performance.

sources.title: AI transformers improve nuclear reactor simulations
sources.snippet: In large language models, transformers analyze relationships among words and sentences. Researchers at Argonne National Laboratory are applying the same underlying concept to physical data, helping them model complex physical systems such as advanced nuclear reactors.
